subject: Bug: Export to PDF crashes the app
body:
Hi team,

Found a reproducible crash. Export to PDF crashes the app on iOS 19.1, iPhone 16 Pro, Acme Notes 3.4.2. It only happens with notes that contain images; text-only notes export fine.

Steps:
1. Open a note with two or more photos in it
2. Tap Share > Export > PDF
3. The app closes immediately (no error message)

Happens every time. Happy to send a screen recording or more details if that helps.

Jonas
